name: The Prince Gallery Tokyo Kioicho
positioning: The Prince Gallery Tokyo Kioicho, a Luxury Collection Hotel: a contemporary high-rise hotel in downtown Tokyo built around the art concept of 'Levitation', with a sky lobby, a 30th-floor indoor pool and a spa
best_for: Travelers who want a high-rise Tokyo base with city views and direct subway access
Guests who enjoy contemporary art and design
Couples looking for a spa and pool stay in the city

facts.text: The hotel is in downtown Tokyo, steps from the Akasaka Prince Classic House and directly connected to the subway station.
Guests arrive in a soaring Sky Lobby with abundant natural light.
Tokyo Garden Terrace Kioicho, where the hotel is situated, has 9 contemporary art pieces installed.
The rooms reflect the design concept 'Levitation'.
Bathrooms include separate tubs and standup showers.
A button in the room lets fresh air circulate from outside.
The hotel has a spa, an indoor pool and a heated public bath.
The gym looks over the city center and is equipped with Technogym equipment from Italy.
Sky Gallery Lounge Levita is a cocktail bar with expansive city views and glass art that resembles a waterfall.
WASHOKU SOUTEN serves modern Japanese cuisine, including sushi and teppanyaki, in a crystal-style interior.
Wi-Fi is free throughout the entire hotel.

highlights.text: The indoor swimming pool is on the 30th floor, with poolside deck chairs facing the window so guests can look over the landscape while lying down.
The hotel displays more than 100 artworks based on the concept of 'Levitation', chosen because it is a high-rise hotel.
In the Deluxe King, the window is set in an alcove with a daybed built along it, and the bathroom's glass walls can be made clear or opaque at the push of a button.
SPA KIOI by SWISS PERFECTION offers a range of treatments, a lap pool and a couple's suite with dramatic views.
The name Kioicho comes from the initials of the Edo-period Kishu Tokugawa, Owari Tokugawa and Hikone Ii families, whose residences stood here about 400 years ago.

considerations.text: The surrounding Nagatacho area is mostly new builds and business towers, though it is prime territory for accessing the rest of the city.
The minimum age to check in is 18.
